result.instructions: Tools for Arthur Online, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which units are vacant or available to let?"; "Show overdue rent transactions for this month."; "Which property certificates have expired?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Arthur Online data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run arthur_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run arthur_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run arthur_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. arthur_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: arthur_create_unit_task
tools.title: Create maintenance task on a unit
tools.description: WRITE: create a maintenance task associated with a unit when the user requests it. Confirm the intended unit and task details first. POST /v2/units/{unit_id}/tasks. No files, tenant invitations or financial changes; creates once and is never retried automatically.

unit_id.description: Arthur numeric record id, from the corresponding list tool.

due_time.description: Due time HH:MM in the Arthur account's local time.

items.description: Arthur numeric record id, from the corresponding list tool.

annotations.title: Create maintenance task on a unit

tools.name: arthur_add_task_note
tools.title: Add note to maintenance task
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to an existing maintenance task when the user requests it. Confirm the intended task and note first. POST /v2/tasks/{task_id}/notes. This creates a note once; it is not a tenant message and is never retried automatically.

task_id.description: Arthur numeric record id, from the corresponding list tool.
